thread:
Ana (AE): Quick ask — Orbit wants a one-week POC with their custom model `llama-adapt-v1-ora`. They expect ~80ms p50 and ~3 RPS sustained. Can we support?
Priya (SE): Do we have the artifact details (size, sharding) and preferred quantization? Also procurement flagged KMS + SOC2 attestation as blockers.
Ana (AE): Artifact is ~12GB sharded across 2 files. They asked for an int8 build first, fallback to fp16. Procurement wants a short risk/cost note.
Ravi (Infra): From infra side: adapter layers use RMSNorm and a tiny custom conv adapter. Shouldn't be a showstopper but need to verify runtime kernel path. I'll queue a Dedicated probe.
Devon (Runtime): If we run int8 and enable KV caching + tuned batching for avg 768 tokens, 80ms p50 is within reach on A10x4 pools. FP16 will be costlier (~1.6x) and a bit slower.
Mia (Solutions): I can run smoke tests — drop me a 3-example JSONL payload and a heavy ~700-token sample to simulate tail.
Ana (AE): Uploading sample prompts in thread now.
security-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood-secure/ques/ORB-2026. Fields required: encryption at rest, KMS key id, SOC2 attestation date, retention policy.
Priya (SE): For procurement note: we can offer BYOK on Private; Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS and we can attach the SOC2 attestation PDF. Which env for the trial — Dedicated preferred?
Ana (AE): They prefer Dedicated but might accept Hosted if we confirm KMS + attestation quickly.
Sales_Ops: Pricing estimates for a 1-week Dedicated trial: baseline + burst ~ $3.5k4k depending on quantization and burst hours. Add a margin for fp16.
Devon (Runtime): Compatibility checklist I'm running now:
- verify ops (rmsnorm, adapter conv)
- run quantization -> int8 path
- start runtime: `rdw-runtime --model /mnt/llama-adapt-v1-ora`
- 10 warmup inferences with KV cache
If custom ops fail we can shim adapter kernels; that could add 1-2 days.
Devon (Runtime): ETA for probe results ~4 hours.
Ravi (Infra): Need expected throughput per instance for capacity planning.
Devon (Runtime): Int8 + KV warm: ~3-5 RPS per A10x instance at 768 tokens. FP16: ~2-3 RPS. These are approximate; probe will confirm.
Mia (Solutions): Sample prompts uploaded: `orbit_prompts.jsonl` (3 lines: two short Q/A, one ~700-token excerpt).
Priya (SE): Drafting procurement note URL: https://redwood-docs/drafts/orbit-procurement-note-v1.md. I'll include mitigations: BYOK, attestation, retention windows, limited trial SLA. Any cost bullets?
Sales_Ops: Add estimated trial cost range: $3.5k6k depending on quantization and burst. Note: fp16 pushes us to higher tier and increases GPU hours.
Ana (AE): Orbit also asked about rolling updates during trial (v1 -> v1.1). Can we pin versions and enable canary?
Devon (Runtime): Yes — we support pinned versions and canary rollouts (10% traffic) for both Dedicated and Hosted. For Dedicated we can do in-place canary, Hosted uses Console rollout policy.
Mia (Solutions): I'm enabling `kv_prefix_cache=true` for repeated system prompts per Orbit request.
Devon (Runtime): Good call. Add `kv_prefix_cache=true` to the experiment config. Also set continuous batching low-latency mode for p50 target.
Ravi (Infra): Created capacity ticket INC-7329 to reserve A10x instances for the trial: https://redwood-ops/tickets/INC-7329
Ana (AE): I'll forward procurement note + sample prompts to Orbit and schedule a technical sync after probe.
Mia (Solutions): Plan: Mia runs probe and smoke tests, Priya finalizes procurement note, Sales_Ops sends official cost sheet, Devon/Ravi confirm perf. Check-in in ~6 hours.
Ana (AE): Thanks team :rocket: 
Priya (SE): Procurement note will call out options: Hosted (RDW KMS + attestation PDF) or Private (BYOK). Also mention retention and logging options.
Devon (Runtime): If probe passes, I'll produce a short perf runbook with tuning knobs (batch size, kv warmup, prefix caching).
Sales_Ops: I'll prep a line-item estimate (GPU hours, bandwidth, support) and attach to the trial agreement.
Ana (AE): Orbit also asked if we can disable telemetry for the trial. Is that possible?
Priya (SE): We can limit telemetry retention and remove PII, but full disable is only for Private deployments (air-gapped). We'll note that in the procurement doc.
Mia (Solutions): Running smoke now. Will post logs in thread if anything flakey.
Devon (Runtime): If everything green, we can spin trial by EOD. If we hit a custom op issue, start contingency plan: shim adapter kernels or request a tiny model repack from Orbit.
Ana (AE): Copy. I'll set the technical call for 2pm PT after your probe updates.
Mia (Solutions): Quick runtime note: enable `max_tokens` guard at 1024 for trial to control tail costs.
Ravi (Infra): Noted. Ticket updated with throughput estimates and guardrails.
Ana (AE): Closing loop for now — will update once probe results arrive. Thanks! :wave:
